explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/592: determine which countable ordinals β have the property that, with α = ω^β, every red/blue colouring of the edges of K_α contains a red K_α or a blue K_3 (Specker, Chang, Galvin–Larson, Schipperus give partial answers; open, $1000). `OrdinalCardinalRamsey α β c` says every 2-colouring (complementary graphs on α.ToType) has a red clique of order type β (`typeLT`) or a blue clique of cardinality c, i.e. α → (β, c)². The statement uses the `@[question value]` pattern with an answer predicate on ordinals: for countable β (β.card <= ℵ₀), ω^β → (ω^β, 3)² iff `erdos_592.answer β`. Faithful; open.
